auth.title: Access Control
auth.description: Enable access control to protect your dashboard data
auth.tokenRequirements: Token must be at least 6 characters with both letters and numbers
auth.tokenHint: Set a memorable but hard-to-guess token
auth.enabledSuccess: Access control enabled, please remember your token
auth.warningDescription: Please keep your access token safe. If you lose it, you won't be able to access the dashboard.
auth.confirmEnableDescription: After enabling access control, all users will need to enter the correct token to access the dashboard.
auth.rememberTokenWarning: Please remember this token! You won't be able to access the dashboard if you lose it!
auth.confirmEnable: I have remembered the token, confirm enable
auth.confirmDisableDescription: After disabling access control, anyone can access your dashboard. Are you sure?
auth.changeTokenDescription: Update your access token to a new one
auth.forceOffWarningDescription: Authentication is forced off via environment variable. You can reset your password without providing the current one.
auth.emergencyResetDescription: You are currently in Emergency Access Mode. After resetting the token, the old one will be invalid.
auth.emergencyResetWarning: For your security, please remove the backend environment variable FORCE_ACCESS_CONTROL_OFF and restart the service after the reset is complete.

health.title: Node Health
health.subtitle: Monitor the online status and data collection continuity of each backend
health.noBackendsHint: Health checks run automatically every minute for all enabled backends and will appear here
health.checkInterval: Health checks are recorded once per minute. Gaps indicate the collector service was interrupted.

monitor.unclassifiedSni: {count} more visible SNI records are unclassified
monitor.error: Monitoring request failed. Check the link and parameters.
monitor.notConnectedHint: Connect your router in Monitoring settings.
monitor.noHistory: No history yet. Recording starts after connection.
monitor.privacyHint: Outbound traffic, DNS and hostname privacy
monitor.routeHint: Compare observed paths with routing rules
monitor.unknownHint: Unrecognized protocols are counted as unknown. Encryption reflects transport protection.
monitor.lanDnsHint: Plaintext queries to the router are not automatically external leaks.
monitor.echHint: ECH offered, TLS 1.3 or absent observed SNI do not prove hostname concealment.
monitor.detailLimit: {count} matching connections; the first 100 are shown. Click a destination for details.
monitor.nodeHint: Per-node probe history. Latency is the request time to the selected HTTP/HTTPS target.
monitor.noNodes: No node history. Check collection and gateway API availability.
monitor.availabilityHint: Success rate is calculated per test.
monitor.historyHint: Observed data since connection only; gaps are not filled with zeros.
monitor.ledgerHint: Current accounting-period totals; approximately {seconds}s refresh. Never added to proxy traffic.
monitor.settingsHint: Protection and collection run on the router; panel or collector outages do not remove protection.
monitor.savedPending: Saved; awaiting router validation, application and acknowledgement.
monitor.linkHint: Regenerating invalidates the previous link. Tokens are for installation only.
monitor.tokenOnce: Shown once only; save in the router private configuration.
monitor.privacySettingsHint: Classification uses Mihomo; independent DoH does not depend on an active proxy.
monitor.nodesSettingsHint: Bound probe frequency and capacity to avoid expensive frequent tests.
monitor.bandwidthSettingsHint: Integrated accounting engine; scope and period affect accounting semantics.
monitor.settingsApplyHint: Validated changes are delivered; the router reports application results.
monitor.hint_monitor_enabled: Observe WAN/LAN metadata with explicit unknowns and dropped-packet status.
monitor.hint_dns_enabled: Take over DNS when the gateway stops; never fall back to plaintext when all resolvers fail.
monitor.hint_core_adapter: Read Mihomo connections and use the core geographical classification.
monitor.hint_disable_offload: Improve capture visibility; may increase router forwarding overhead.
monitor.hint_wan_interface: Enter the actual device name; auto reads the WAN device.
monitor.hint_resolver_url: HTTPS DNS endpoint, Ali by default; server certificates are verified.
monitor.hint_fallback_url: HTTPS DNS endpoint after primary failure; Tencent DNSPod by default.
monitor.hint_fallback_ips: Comma-separated fixed resolver IPs to avoid plaintext DNS bootstrap.
monitor.hint_watch_domain: Enter domains to watch, separated by commas.
monitor.hint_dns_port: Avoid existing listeners; 53531, 53532 and 53533 are reserved internally.
monitor.hint_enabled: Control this module only; does not change the OpenClash proxy switch.
monitor.hint_interval: 120 seconds by default; probes are staggered.
monitor.hint_timeout: 3000 ms by default; timeout alone does not prove node failure.
monitor.hint_max_nodes: Bound scheduled nodes; exceeding capacity must show a coverage gap.
monitor.hint_keep_samples: Recent sample limit per node, plus seven-day hourly aggregates.
monitor.hint_persistent: Infrequent checkpoints preserve history through migration and reboot.
monitor.hint_targets: Comma-separated full HTTP/HTTPS URLs; at most the first two are used.
monitor.hint_refresh_interval: 30 seconds by default; constrains device-curve precision.
monitor.hint_commit_interval: Daily by default to reduce flash writes; power loss can lose uncommitted usage.
monitor.hint_database_generations: Preserve old ledgers during migration; remove oldest periods after the limit.
monitor.hint_database_interval: Day of month starting a new period; day 1 by default.
monitor.hint_local_network: CIDRs or router logical interface names, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24 or LAN, separated by commas.
monitor.hint_resolver_ips: Fixed IPv4/IPv6 addresses for primary DoH, separated by commas; avoids a DNS bootstrap dependency.
monitor.unclassifiedHint: {count} connections are unclassified and excluded from domestic/overseas statistics.
monitor.hint_database_limit: Maximum records per period. Recommended: 10000. Zero removes the record limit; process memory remains bounded.
monitor.hint_netlink_buffer_size: Bytes; recommended 524288. Small buffers can lose connection events.
monitor.hint_database_prealloc: Reserve ledger records on startup. Off by default to reduce idle memory.
monitor.hint_database_compress: Compress ledger files when saving; enabled by default.
monitor.probeQueued: Probe queued; results appear after the next collection.
monitor.probeError: Probe not queued; retry later (once per 30 seconds).
monitor.scopeEmpty: No traffic records in this scope yet
monitor.accountScopeHint: LAN devices are identified by LAN interface subnets. Router traffic and other networks are separate; all records can include both sides of a proxied connection.

coreControl.title: Core control
coreControl.subtitle: Proxies, connections, rules and runtime settings
coreControl.search: Search names, devices, destinations or rules…
coreControl.failed: Action failed: controller unavailable, feature unsupported or request rejected. Refresh and retry.
coreControl.unavailable: Core control unavailable. Check the Mihomo controller; Agent and Surge backends are unsupported.
coreControl.logsHint: Logs are subscribed on demand, bounded to 200 entries and released after leaving this page.
coreControl.runtimeHint: Changes apply to the running kernel. OpenClash may overwrite them when regenerating config; use its manager for persistent settings. Independent DNS protection keeps its settings.
coreControl.confirmHint: Closing connections or flushing caches may interrupt current activity.
coreControl.detailHint: Actual kernel metadata; sniffed domains are not treated as egress SNI evidence.
coreControl.recordLimit: First 200 matching records. Search to narrow the results.

openclashControl.expired: Action timed out. Refresh and retry.
openclashControl.confirm: This changes the router proxy service.
